description: Cameo Q-Spot 15 RGBW pinspot (18 W RGBW LED). Five DMX modes; the fixture's display picks one, the Rig page must say the same. 4CH is the default (plain RGBW, as in the first versions).

modes.name: 2CH
modes.description: Dimmer (follows the brightness) and a colour macro held at White. No colour mixing.

modes.name: 3CH-1
modes.description: Dimmer (follows the brightness), strobe and a colour macro held at White. No colour mixing.

modes.name: 4CH
modes.description: Red, green, blue, white. The plain colour mode.

modes.name: 9CH
modes.description: Dimmer, dimmer fine, strobe, red, green, blue, white, colour macro, colour temperature. The dimmer is held at full, the colours carry the brightness.

_note: Modes and channel tables from the manual (raw/fixtures/Cameo_Q_Spot_15_RGBW.pdf in the PitchPlease wiki). 4-channel mode confirmed 2026-10-05. Colour macro 114 = White (110-117); strobe 250 = fastest before the 'open' range of the 9CH mode.
